name: Torta della Nonna
description: Grandmother's tart of tender shortcrust pastry filled with lemon pastry cream and topped with pine nuts.
ingredients: a generous handful of yellow onions
a handful of fresh rosemary, chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven (or set up your steamer or frying station) and lightly grease your pan or molds with extra-virgin olive oil.
In a large bowl, whisk together the spaghetti and fennel seeds until evenly combined.
In a separate bowl, blend the pine nuts with the vegetable stock until smooth and well incorporated.
Gently fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, taking care not to overmix.
Transfer everything to your prepared pan or molds and cook — bake, steam, chill, or fry — until set, about 35 mins.
Remove from the heat and let it cool completely; this helps the texture firm up perfectly.
tips: Resist opening the oven door too early — a sudden change in temperature can cause the dessert to sink or crack.
Bring your pine nuts to room temperature before mixing for a smoother, more even texture.
For the cleanest slices, chill the finished dessert thoroughly before cutting.
